title: El Dominó de Jerez, MEXI STORIES
comment: domino-jerez (MEXI): cantina antigua de Jerez, Zacatecas, de tarde. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.SEVERO_LECHUGA: Mexican regional boss from Zacatecas, 68 years old, heavy-set, light-brown weathered skin, grey hair, a thick grey mustache, a black felt cowboy hat, a dark-brown leather jacket over a black western shirt, silver rings, black boots, his hands empty.
chars.JULIAN_ROSALES: Mexican man, 35 years old, brown skin, short black hair, a short black beard, calm dark eyes, a tan canvas jacket over a white t-shirt, jeans, brown boots, his hands empty.
chars.TONO_CARRILLO: Mexican cantina owner, 58 years old, bald with grey sides, a round face, a grey mustache, a checked red-and-black flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, a white towel over one shoulder, dark trousers, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_CANTINAJEREZ: Old traditional cantina in Jerez, Zacatecas, in the late afternoon: a long dark wooden bar with shelves of unlabeled bottles, a square wooden table with domino tiles, wooden chairs, ceiling fans, old tiled floor, warm light through swinging doors, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
